title: All-hands Aug 2026 - Talking points & Q&A (draft)
content:
Purpose:
Quick draft of talking points + Q&A for the Aug 2026 all-hands. Not polished - notes to self and suggested language for execs. Final numbers and final slide deck TBD (Samira to sync).

TL;DR (2 lines):
- We had another quarter of sustained growth: usage up ~35% QoQ; Hosted ARR expansion on track.
- Product + infra wins: Dedicated capacity GA improvements, private deploy onboarding friction down, latency improvements on common gen workloads.

Company highlights (what to call out):
- Usage: +35% QoQ active API keys; top 10 customers increased committed capacity (internal metric: DC-commits). NOTE: confirm exact ARR lift with finance (TODO).
- Dedicated: reduced p99 tail latency by ~18% after kernel selection changes - reference bench slides.
- Private: first two pilots in healthcare completed security assessment; one pilot signed LOI for enterprise deployment.
- Regions: EU region capacity increased; devs in APAC report lower latency in Singapore staging.
- Cost optimizations: Redwood Optimize recommendations rolled out for top 5 customers; early results show ~12% token-cost reduction.

Product / Tech updates (short bullets):
- Serving runtime: ongoing kernel + KV cache changes - measured improvement for long-context (>4k) workloads.
- Smart routing: canary tests for multi-region fallback mature; plan to enable by default for enterprise tier in Sep.
- Streaming and tool-calls: improved resiliency in interrupted connections - fewer client retries observed.
- Roadmap teaser: quantized Llama family variants in catalog, better CPU-fallback path for small latency-sensitive models.

GTM / Customers (what Sales/CS want mentioned):
- PLG motion is working: self-serve onboarding conversion lifted after new quickstart templates.
- Enterprise: 3 deals in late-stage with Dedicated + Private; PS engagements being scoped for onboarding.

People & org notes:
- Hiring: we are still actively recruiting infra and SRE roles; hiring scoreboard slide to include updated reqs.
- Promotions: call out engineering IC promotions (Priya/Noah) - confirm with HR before announcing.
- Shoutouts: call out recent oncall/incident heroics (Kai, Lucas) + product design for UX improvements (Emily).

OKRs / metrics to highlight (high level; avoid committing to exact numbers until final):
- Latency SLO improvements (p50/p95/p99) - show trend in slides.
- Cost per 1k tokens for common prompt shapes - show before/after with Optimize.

What I want execs to say (suggested phrasing):
- "We shipped meaningful infra work that improves customer experience and unlocks better economics - that lets customers build with confidence and scale."
- "Our focus remains: predictable, reliable inference at lower unit cost. Next quarter we'll push on private deployments and enterprise SLAs."

Anticipated Q&A (prepare 1-2 line answers):
Q: "Are we losing ground to cloud providers offering managed endpoints?"
A: "We differentiate on production economics + developer experience - multi-deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private) and the Optimize toolkit are stickier than simple endpoint access."

Q: "Any risk on capacity / spot GPU shortages?"
A: "We've diversified regions and partner capacity; Dedicated customers get reserved pools and automated fallback to compatible model variants."

Q: "How are we measuring quality regressions when switching quantized models?"
A: "We tie regressions to eval prompt suites and alert on quality drift; we run canaries and rollback when necessary."

Q: "What does this mean for pricing?"
A: "No immediate pricing changes to announce. Longer term we may evolve unit pricing by model/variant and offer cost-optimized tiers."

Notes to self / TODOs before final: (keep short)
- [ ] Confirm ARR / revenue lift numbers with finance (Samira).
- [ ] Finalize slide deck + graphics (Jordan).
- [ ] HR confirmation on promotions and new hire announcements (Priya).
- [ ] Get legal signoff on customer names we can call out publicly.

Open questions / risky items to surface during prep call:
- Do we call out specific customer logos? (legal + CS input needed)
- Any ongoing incidents that should be disclosed or mentioned? (SRE)
- Are we comfortable sharing cost reduction percentages publicly or keep them internal?

Rough timing (for slide flow):
1) CEO intro & TL;DR (2-3 min)
2) Product + infra wins (3-4 min)
3) Customer/GTM wins & pipeline (2-3 min)
4) People & org updates (2 min)
5) Q&A (15 min) - collect questions live + prep panel (CEO, CTO, Head of Product)

Staging notes:
- Keep slides light on numbers; have appendix with detailed metrics for follow-up.
- Call out the specific ask from teams: finalize 1-2 talking points per exec.

Scratchpad / alternate lines (more candid):
- "We made big improvements that customers feel in latency and cost, but we still need tighter incident playbooks for cross-region failovers."
- "We're investing in Private because regulated customers want both control and performance - this is a top-three investment area for next year."

Last-minute reminder: sync with Samira on Monday 8/3 10am to lock numbers and deck.

---
History: started as quick notes 2026-07-28; iterated with Samira and Jordan 2026-07-30 and 2026-07-31.
